planner.description: Plans multi-file, risky or UI changes test-first before code is written. Use before any change touching more than one file, money/tax, sync, ports or a screen.

explorer.description: Fast read-only repo search: where something lives, how a flow works, whether a helper already exists.

test-author.description: Writes the failing integration or e2e tests for a planned change before implementation.

implementer.description: Implements one planned slice in packages/apps to make its already-written tests pass.

ui-builder.description: Builds screens and components from Figma with @shopper/ui, no effects, every state, keyboard-first, verified with screenshots.

checker.description: Runs vp check, vp run guard and the test suite and returns only the failures.

reviewer.description: Reviews changes before commit by running Codex review (gpt-6.1-sol) and verifying each finding. Use before every commit or PR.

ui-reviewer.description: Reviews UI changes against Figma, frontend rules and accessibility using real screenshots.
